speaker: Doctor
text: How long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and does the cough produce any phlegm or blood?

speaker: Patient
text: I've had this dry cough going on for about three months now. It doesn't bring up any phlegm or blood, but it does make me feel quite short of breath when I try to play basketball. speaker: Doctor
text: That is a significant finding; given the confirmed elevated cortisol and your symptoms, have you noticed any recent weight gain, particularly in the face or upper back, or changes in your skin like purple stretch marks? DIAGNOSIS READY: Cushing's Syndrome
